kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From ذُو (ḏū, “possessor of, having”) + الـ (al-, “the”) + فَقَار (faqār, “vertebrae, spine”), variously interpreted as being a notched-sword, as “the spine-cleaver”, or as “the one having the ability to dice into pieces” like the segmentation of a vertebra.
s: ذُو (ḏū, “possessor of, having”) + الـ (al-, “the”) + فَقَار (faqār, “vertebrae, spine”)
g: A famous mythical weapon of Ali ibn Abi Talib, previously belonging to Muhammad.
a male given name enjoying greater popularity among Shi'a Muslims.
